Future<void> run(dynamic items, dynamic save, int width) async {
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 4, save, 1);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 1, save, 4);
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, save, 1, retries: 5);
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 1, save, width: 4);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 4, save, width: 1);
  const local = 1;
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await pool.mapWithConcurrency<int, void>(items, save, local);
}
